_readme: Catalog for adameivy.com. Videos show in the order listed, so put the newest first. To add one, copy an entry, change the fields and push. `type` is "music-video" or "short-film". `youtube` is the 11-character video id (the part after youtu.be/); it plays inline and supplies the thumbnail. For a self-hosted file use `video` (an .mp4 URL) and `poster` instead. With neither, the player links out to the X post. `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional. Every key in `links` is optional (without a `spotify` or `appleMusic` track link, that button opens the artist page from `channel`); extra links go in `links.other` as {"label", "url"}. Set `featured: true` on the one to show large at the top (otherwise the first entry is used).

videos.title: Nein, Nicht, Nie
videos.description: When we lived in Germany, my two-year-old, in fits of uncontrollable laughter upon being tickled, would scream ‘Nein! Nicht! Nie!’, which inspired the lyrics. Now that she’s an adult and learning more languages, I was mulling this over, started toying with the chorus, and away it went. This required a lot of human-written lyrics by hand and dozens of iterations to get the sound right. Fable 5.2 helped animate this in Blender.

videos.title: The Cutting Room Floor
videos.description: The video that took the most iterations, and produced the most new tooling in PortOS along the way. The starting idea came from a Facebook reply to Scale of the Universe.

videos.title: Scale of the Universe
videos.description: Arrived while falling asleep, by way of Accelerando and the question of what a human-readable signal in SETI would even look like. Many shots were re-rendered and reordered before it felt right.

videos.title: You Are the Room
videos.description: Grew out of a reply on X to a critique of the Chinese Room argument: what if the room itself is what holds the knowledge?
